svg.title: Proposal B — Specialized Views (per-tool rendering)
svg.text: Find all files containing "parse_tool_call" and fix the error handling
OTHER SPECIALIZED VIEWS (shown when relevant tool selected)
• Each tool type gets its own renderer: Bash→terminal, Edit→diff, Read→file, Grep→results
• Generic fallback: pretty JSON input + monospace output for unrecognized tools (MCP, etc.)
• Registry pattern: HashMap<tool_name, Box<dyn ToolRenderer>> — extensible for new tools
• Command/file preview extracted from input_json: Bash→"$ cmd", Read→"file:lines", Edit→"file +N −M"
• Error chips: red left border, red icon circle, "exit N" badge
• Grep chips: match count suffix (→ N matches)
• For Edit: compute unified diff from old_string/new_string in input_json at render time
• No DB schema change needed — diff is derived from existing stored data
Edit→diff • Bash→terminal • Read→file viewer • Grep→results list • Generic→JSON+mono fallback
Bash/shell → TerminalView | Read → FileView | Edit → DiffView | Grep/Search → ResultsView
Write → FileView | Glob → FileListView | Agent/Task → SubagentView | * → GenericJsonView
